head: af6dbfc9
basis: One pin per rung of ARC/stem/ladder.json. The pin's text is the rung's standard sentence, copied verbatim from the proposal document so a re-runnable check can locate it. The pin's tier is the banding that document section 3 assigns the rung, and it is the tier the pin can honestly be held to, not a claim that the standard has external standing.
authority_note: Every pin here cites a document this tree wrote. Locating the sentence proves the registry and the proposal agree and have not drifted; it does not prove the standard has standing with any accreditor, board or professional body, because none was read at source. That is recorded once here rather than repeated as a false strength on each pin.

pins.demand: A representation of a quantity, plus an explanation another person can follow
pins.authority: This tree's ladder proposal, section 2 (E0). No external standard read at source.
pins.text: Given a quantity, produces a representation (tally, array, number line) and an explanation a listener can follow.
pins.verified: verbatim standard sentence located in the cited document by the wing checklist
pins.satisfied_by: nothing in this tree: E0's instrument is declared blind in ARC/stem/ladder.json
pins.does_not_prove: That any learner reached this rung. No corpus of learner work exists here, so the pin records the standard and nothing about attainment.

pins.demand: A measured value with its unit and its repeat, distinguished from an impression
pins.authority: This tree's ladder proposal, section 2 (E1). No external standard read at source.
pins.text: Takes a measurement, states its unit and its repeat, and distinguishes "I measured 3.2 cm" from "it is big".
pins.verified: verbatim standard sentence located in the cited document by the wing checklist
pins.satisfied_by: nothing in this tree: E1's instrument is declared blind in ARC/stem/ladder.json
pins.does_not_prove: That a notebook entry was ever read for this distinction. The artifact is prose a program cannot grade.

pins.demand: An investigation designed so it could fail, with uncertainty reported and an evidence-based argument
pins.authority: This tree's ladder proposal, section 2 (E2), which cites NGSS practice 6-8 as shape rather than as text read here.
pins.text: Designs an investigation that could fail, reports uncertainty, and argues from the evidence rather than from authority (NGSS practice 6–8; AP/IB capstone shape).
pins.verified: verbatim standard sentence located in the cited document by the wing checklist
pins.satisfied_by: tools/check_corpus_quotes.py, and only the narrow slice that proves a quotation
pins.does_not_prove: Competence in investigation design. The instrument grades whether a quote matches its producer, which is one component of one sentence of the rung.

pins.demand: A published result reproduced from its stated method, in an environment the reproducer did not author
pins.authority: This tree's ladder proposal, section 2 (E3). No external standard read at source.
pins.text: Reproduces a published result from its stated method, in an environment they did not author.
pins.verified: verbatim standard sentence located in the cited document by the wing checklist
pins.satisfied_by: tools/check_corpus_quotes.py: the same prove-against-the-producer discipline at document scale, with a printed denominator
pins.does_not_prove: That a reproduction ran. The instrument proves quoted text, not a command re-executed on foreign inputs.

pins.demand: A small study whose data, code and README let a stranger obtain the same table unaided
pins.authority: This tree's ladder proposal, section 2 (E4). No external standard read at source.
pins.text: Designs and executes a small study whose data, code and README let someone else get the same table without asking a question.
pins.verified: verbatim standard sentence located in the cited document by the wing checklist
pins.satisfied_by: tools/arc_provenance.py (named file re-hashed against a recorded digest) plus tools/golden_arrow.py as the bounded one-command runner
pins.does_not_prove: That the study's numbers are right. A digest proves the bytes are the bytes that were graded, and 0 defects is possible only when they are present; it says nothing about whether the analysis was sound.

pins.demand: A question and its analysis plan registered before the data, and an answer reported including what disappointed
pins.authority: This tree's ladder proposal, section 2 (E5), which defines its own tier A by reference to ARC/esquire/pins.json.
pins.text: States a question and its analysis plan *before* collecting data, then reports the answer including the parts that disappointed.
pins.verified: verbatim standard sentence located in the cited document by the wing checklist
pins.satisfied_by: tools/arc_provenance.py: the tier-A discipline (operative text retained and re-hashable) that a replication package must meet
pins.does_not_prove: That anything was pre-registered. Tier A here means the text was located in this tree, not that an external registry holds a timestamp.

pins.demand: A method chosen for the question, with the rejected methods and the different questions they would have answered
pins.authority: This tree's ladder proposal, section 2 (E6). No external standard read at source.
pins.text: Chooses a method because it answers the question, and can say why the rejected methods would have answered a different one.
pins.verified: verbatim standard sentence located in the cited document by the wing checklist
pins.satisfied_by: tools/reading_audit.py: a verdict must carry its denominator or it is denominator_free
pins.does_not_prove: That the power or precision argument was sound. The instrument catches a verdict with no population, which is one way this rung fails.

pins.demand: An original, defended contribution with null and negative results at the same prominence as the positive ones
pins.authority: This tree's ladder proposal, section 2 (E7). No external standard read at source.
pins.text: An original contribution, defended, with the null and negative results reported at the same prominence as the positive ones.
pins.verified: verbatim standard sentence located in the cited document by the wing checklist
pins.satisfied_by: tools/leg_ledger.py: ok, empty, skipped and error may never collapse into one line of prose
pins.does_not_prove: Originality, or that a defense happened. The instrument grades whether four leg states stayed distinct in a report.

pins.demand: A funded line of work independent of the advisor, producing another researcher, with claims surviving outside replication
pins.authority: This tree's ladder proposal, section 2 (E8). No external standard read at source.
pins.text: A funded line of work that continues without the doctoral advisor, that produces at least one other researcher, and whose claims survive an outside replication.
pins.verified: verbatim standard sentence located in the cited document by the wing checklist
pins.satisfied_by: pmb__lesson_impact (MCP tool served by the pmb daemon, not a file in this tree): which lessons moved an outcome, with lift against a no-lesson baseline
pins.does_not_prove: That a research line exists. The instrument measures lesson lift inside this tree, which is the same shape of question at a much smaller scale.
